reviewMethod.wholeSourcePurity: Full-source 15 fps whole-body and lower-body evidence was directly visually reviewed before counting. Any alternate-foot, high-knee, cross/scissor step, crossover, side-swing, or other mixed subtype rejects the clip from STANDARD.
reviewMethod.densePassReview: The single PASS clip was rechecked across the complete 15 fps sequence; 24 locator-centered event windows were then visually verified as real synchronized two-foot takeoff/airborne/landing cycles, with start/end boundaries checked.
reviewMethod.locatorPolicy: Programmatic image/motion analysis was used only to suggest candidate cycle timestamps. Type and GT count were decided by direct visual inspection.
